item.title: Virginia’s fall fire season ends
item.description: CHARLOTTESVILLE, VA – During this year’s fall fire season, which ran from Oct. 15 to Nov. 30, the Virginia Department of Forestry (DOF) suppressed 152 wildfires that burned 1,733 acres and damaged two outbuildings.
